actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.run-query.props.application_name: An identifier for the client application executing the query.
actions.run-query.props.args.description: Add all arguments as names here, don't add the $ sign.
actions.run-query.props.markdown.descrip: **NOTE:** Prevent SQL injection by using parameterized queries.
actions.run-query.props.query.descriptio: Provide a SurrealDB query string to execute.
actions.run-query.props.queryMarkdown.de: **NOTE:** Query example: `SELECT * FROM table_name WHERE name = $name`. Then add the name parameter in the arguments.
actions.run-query.props.query_timeout.de: The maximum time to wait for a query to complete before timing out.
actions.surrealdb_count_records.descript: Counts the records in a table that match filters.
actions.surrealdb_count_records.props.fi: JSON object of conditions, all combined with AND. {"field": value} matches equality; {"field": {"$gt": 18}} uses an operator: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $containsNot, $containsAny, $containsAll, $exists (true/false). Nested fields use dots ("address.city"). Wrap a value as {"$record": "user:tobie"}, {"$datetime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"$decimal": "1.50"}, {"$uuid": "..."} or {"$duration": "1h"} to compare against that SurrealDB type; plain strings stay strings.
actions.surrealdb_count_records.props.ta: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_create_record.descript: Creates a record in a table.
actions.surrealdb_create_record.props.da: JSON object of field values, e.g. {"name": "Tobie", "age": 33}. Strings are stored as strings; use Run Query to store record links or datetimes.
actions.surrealdb_create_record.props.id: The id part only, without the table, e.g. "tobie" for "person:tobie". Leave empty to generate one.
actions.surrealdb_create_record.props.ta: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_delete_record.descript: Permanently deletes one record by its id.
actions.surrealdb_delete_record.props.re: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
actions.surrealdb_delete_records.descrip: Permanently deletes every record that matches filters.
actions.surrealdb_delete_records.props.f: JSON object of conditions, all combined with AND. {"field": value} matches equality; {"field": {"$gt": 18}} uses an operator: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $containsNot, $containsAny, $containsAll, $exists (true/false). Nested fields use dots ("address.city"). Wrap a value as {"$record": "user:tobie"}, {"$datetime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"$decimal": "1.50"}, {"$uuid": "..."} or {"$duration": "1h"} to compare against that SurrealDB type; plain strings stay strings.
actions.surrealdb_delete_records.props.m: Safety limit: if the filters match more records than this, nothing is changed and the action fails. Defaults to 100.
actions.surrealdb_delete_records.props.t: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_describe_table.descrip: Gets a table's fields, indexes, events and views.
actions.surrealdb_describe_table.props.t: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_export_database.descri: Exports the database as a SurrealQL file.
true to export the records as well as the definitions, false for definitions only. Defaults to true.
Only export these tables, e.g. ["person", "knows"]. Leave empty for all tables.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.descripti: Finds records in a table using filters, sorting and paging.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.fie: Fields to return, e.g. ["id", "name", "address.city"]. Leave empty for all fields.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.fil: JSON object of conditions, all combined with AND. {"field": value} matches equality; {"field": {"$gt": 18}} uses an operator: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $containsNot, $containsAny, $containsAll, $exists (true/false). Nested fields use dots ("address.city"). Wrap a value as {"$record": "user:tobie"}, {"$datetime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"$decimal": "1.50"}, {"$uuid": "..."} or {"$duration": "1h"} to compare against that SurrealDB type; plain strings stay strings.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.lim: Max records to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.ord: Field to sort by, e.g. "created_at" or "address.city". Leave empty for no particular order.
ASC or DESC. Defaults to ASC.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.sta: Number of records to skip, for paging. Use next_start from the previous call with the same filters and order.
actions.surrealdb_find_records.props.tab: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_find_related_records.d: Finds the records linked to a record through an edge table.
actions.surrealdb_find_related_records.p: outgoing: edges from this record; incoming: edges to it; both. Defaults to outgoing.
Name of the edge table, e.g. "knows".
Max records to return (1-1000). Defaults to 100.
Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
Number of edges to skip, for paging. Use next_start from the previous call.
actions.surrealdb_get_database_info.desc: Gets everything defined in the connected database.
actions.surrealdb_get_record.description: Gets one record by its id.
actions.surrealdb_get_record.props.recor: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
actions.surrealdb_import_data.descriptio: Imports a SurrealQL script or export file into the database.
actions.surrealdb_import_data.props.file: A .surql file to import, such as one from Export Database. Leave empty when using Script.
actions.surrealdb_import_data.props.scri: SurrealQL statements to import, e.g. CREATE person:tobie SET name = "Tobie";. Leave empty when using File.
actions.surrealdb_insert_records.descrip: Inserts several records into a table in one statement.
actions.surrealdb_insert_records.props.r: JSON array of record objects, e.g. [{"name": "Ada"}, {"id": "alan", "name": "Alan"}]. An "id" is the id part only, without the table.
actions.surrealdb_insert_records.props.t: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_list_databases.descrip: Lists the databases in the connection's namespace.
actions.surrealdb_list_namespaces.descri: Lists the namespaces on the SurrealDB server.
actions.surrealdb_list_tables.descriptio: Lists the tables defined in the connected database.
actions.surrealdb_merge_record.descripti: Updates some fields of an existing record.
actions.surrealdb_merge_record.props.dat: JSON object of field values, e.g. {"name": "Tobie", "age": 33}. Strings are stored as strings; use Run Query to store record links or datetimes.
actions.surrealdb_merge_record.props.rec: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
actions.surrealdb_patch_record.descripti: Applies JSON Patch operations to an existing record.
actions.surrealdb_patch_record.props.rec: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
actions.surrealdb_relate_records.descrip: Creates a graph edge from one record to another.
actions.surrealdb_relate_records.props.d: Optional JSON object of fields stored on the edge, e.g. {"since": 2020}.
actions.surrealdb_relate_records.props.e: Name of the edge table, e.g. "knows" or "purchased". Created if it does not exist.
actions.surrealdb_relate_records.props.f: Record the edge starts at, in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie".
actions.surrealdb_relate_records.props.t: Record the edge points to, in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:jaime".
actions.surrealdb_replace_record.descrip: Replaces all fields of an existing record.
actions.surrealdb_replace_record.props.d: JSON object of field values, e.g. {"name": "Tobie", "age": 33}. Strings are stored as strings; use Run Query to store record links or datetimes.
actions.surrealdb_replace_record.props.r: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
actions.surrealdb_run_function.descripti: Runs a custom or built-in SurrealDB function with arguments.
actions.surrealdb_run_function.props.arg: JSON array of positional arguments, e.g. ["Tobie", 33]. Leave empty for none.
actions.surrealdb_run_gql_query.descript: Runs an ISO GQL graph query, e.g. MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.
actions.surrealdb_run_gql_query.props.qu: GQL statement, e.g. MATCH (p:person) RETURN p.
actions.surrealdb_run_graphql_query.desc: Runs a GraphQL query against the database.
actions.surrealdb_run_graphql_query.prop: GraphQL query, e.g. { person(limit: 10) { id name } }.
Optional JSON object of GraphQL variables.
actions.surrealdb_update_records.descrip: Merges fields into every record that matches filters.
actions.surrealdb_update_records.props.d: JSON object of field values, e.g. {"name": "Tobie", "age": 33}. Strings are stored as strings; use Run Query to store record links or datetimes.
actions.surrealdb_update_records.props.f: JSON object of conditions, all combined with AND. {"field": value} matches equality; {"field": {"$gt": 18}} uses an operator: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $contains, $containsNot, $containsAny, $containsAll, $exists (true/false). Nested fields use dots ("address.city"). Wrap a value as {"$record": "user:tobie"}, {"$datetime": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, {"$decimal": "1.50"}, {"$uuid": "..."} or {"$duration": "1h"} to compare against that SurrealDB type; plain strings stay strings.
actions.surrealdb_update_records.props.m: Safety limit: if the filters match more records than this, nothing is changed and the action fails. Defaults to 100.
actions.surrealdb_update_records.props.t: Table name, e.g. "person". Use List Tables to find it.
actions.surrealdb_upsert_record.descript: Creates a record or merges fields into it if it exists.
actions.surrealdb_upsert_record.props.da: JSON object of field values, e.g. {"name": "Tobie", "age": 33}. Strings are stored as strings; use Run Query to store record links or datetimes.
actions.surrealdb_upsert_record.props.re: Full record id in "table:id" form, e.g. "person:tobie", as returned in the id field by Find Records, Create Record and the other record actions.
auth.props.database.description: A string indicating the name of the database to connect to.
auth.props.namespace.description: As string indicating the namespace of the database to connect to.
auth.props.password.description: As string indicating the password of the database to connect to.
auth.props.username.description: As string indicating the username of the database to connect to.
triggers.new-row.description: Triggers when a new row is added to the defined table.
triggers.new-row.props.description.descr: **NOTE:** The trigger fetches the latest rows using the provided order by column (newest first), and then will keep polling until the previous last row is reached. It's suggested to add a created_at timestamp. `DEFINE FIELD OVERWRITE createdAt ON schedule VALUE time::now() READONLY;`
triggers.new-row.props.order_by.descript: Use something like a created timestamp.
triggers.new-row.props.order_direction.d: The direction to sort by such that the newest rows are fetched first.
